# Causal shapes a regex cannot judge

Upstream compromise prior to release publication is a threat window,
not a record of what this repo once did.

A swapped or corrupted upstream asset fails the build.

If the pair is not found, the var block was reshaped and this gate
would silently stop covering it.

A quoted `previously` keeps the file in the advisory candidate set, so
the shapes above are scanned rather than set aside.
